description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests to verify Git's handling of CRLF line endings during merge conflicts. It sets up a Git repository, creates branches, commits files with specific line endings, and checks the behavior of merge operations involving CRLF conversions.

methods.name: append_cr
methods.description: Appends a CRLF to input data (assumed as a helper function defined in 'test-lib.sh')

methods.name: remove_cr
methods.description: Removes CR characters from input data (assumed as a helper function defined in 'test-lib.sh')

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the previous command fails
